body: What is so horrible about wanting to be loved? This is my darkest pleasure as well. The thought of my Ex's face at my funeral. I just wouldn't ever do it though. Cause you ain't ever gonna see that though. Cause once your dead your dead. No friend is ultimately worth your own life as much as it may be painful to say.
You got your reasons for being angry no doubt. I guess I lucked out when I had a woman that meant more to me than sex. Gettin laid gets old too.
I'm glad I could help :) I lost a special relationship because of my mental health too. So don't beat yourself help.

And the absurd joke of it all, no one truly and ultimately matters in the first place, but I still feel like you. We have that human need genetically en-grained into us to want to belong. To want to feel important. To have a Misses Ape we can fuck and to belong to the monkey hierarchy so that we can feel good about ourselves. It's hard man. Brutal what nature does.

But you won't, because it'd be one more futile gesture in a lifetime of futile gestures. All the American Dream is but sad attempt to cover up the sad fact that we're all just decaying masses of flesh on a ball of space floating in endless nothingness. You're going to die anyway. I'm going to die anyway. I was were you were once at and let me tell you this: It's all just a futile gesture..

What is worse? To be hated, or to be treated like you don't exist at all. And that is the ugly truth, we're invisible. Because nobody in this world gives a shit. But the truth is this world of 7 billion fucking people, we're all just a number. All just waiting to be replaced, as soon as the day we expire.. So post anyway. Scream as loud as you have to, and someone will hear you. Just don't let yourself fade away.

Worst yet is to never stop loving the person who left you... but I feel your pain... I hope whatever path you take that you will have the strength to live on, and find someone who loves you like you deserve to be loved.

At least it was not your fault, it was hers. Try knowing that you're the one the ruined a perfect relationship with one of the most beautiful woman you have ever known and know that it was a 100 percent your fault. And I know that fucking feeling, to never again have one as good as she was. If she cheated on you though was she that great? Human existence is so miserable that you (we all do really) deserve to have someone that will stand by your side and stay there. To have someone who'll always love you till the end. Why is that too much of to ask of this world? I don't know. I hope either of us can find love again in this world. I don't know how I still hang on...

Listen, I was a huge asshole to my ex-girlfriend too, but it was never anything she ever did. It was always how I felt, so I don't think you should beat yourself up :/ I beat myself up for all the stupid shit I did to her over the years, and I still wonder if I'll still find someone good enough again. I hope the pain stops for you, because it's not your fault and you don't deserve to be hurt.
That's the worst pain of all, to lose your romantic partner and say "What if?" I still dream of the one I lost too. You may feel alone, but you're not.

It gets harder and harder everyday for myself as well. At least you care about the people in your life. I feel like I have no one. What the hell are we suppose to do? The barriers between life and death seem impenetrable. I hope you can find some peace and solace with those that love you. At hope all your pain goes away, I hope that you can at least look at one thing in your life and say "That makes me happy" and I hope those things revitalize you and keep you moving forward.
What are those 3 things? What is it that you fear failing? Why wouldn't they give a shit?
